ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity white/cream pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels across the visible surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Broad white/cream contiguous regions occupy the outer 2/3 of both lobes. Central peduncle-adjacent region and lower-medial sections are dominated by dark pigmentation. Numerous small, circular dark-pigmented 'rosette' spots are localized within the white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 65 degrees and a bounding box depth roughly 15% of the total fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serration pattern observed along the entire trailing edge boundary, with pixel-amplitude peaks ranging from 3 to 10 pixels; most pronounced and jagged at the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Strongly concave upward curve from the median notch extending to the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dozens of circular, dark-bordered pixel clusters (barnacle attachment scars) distributed across the white pigmentation of both lobes, notably clustered in the mid-section of the right lobe and upper-mid section of the left lobe.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct vertical white linear marks (rake marks) visible on the dark pigmentation of the right lobe near the midline; one thin diagonal scratch on the upper white field of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive clusters of textured, high-relief biological growth (barnacles) present at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes, characterized by brownish-yellow pixel coloration.
